original_question: For p > 2 with p not an even integer, are all minimizers of the p-frame energy I_F(mu) = integral integral |<x, y>|^p dmu(x) dmu(y) on S^(d-1) discrete measures?
target_in_paper: Section 4, Conjecture 4.1 (“Minimizers of the p-frame energy”) of arXiv:2504.04845; this is the nearest official formulation of your draft, and it is the p>2 restriction of the broader Conjecture 1.1 in the cited paper Energy on spheres and discreteness of minimizing measures. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
correct_elements: The draft already captures the right problem: it uses the correct p-frame energy kernel |⟨x,y⟩|^p on S^{d-1}, asks about all minimizers rather than existence of one minimizer, and isolates exactly the unresolved range emphasized in Section 4, namely p>2 with p not an even integer. The surrounding paragraph also matches the paper’s context that this question comes after the known empty-interior result for non-even p. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
missing_details: State explicitly that μ ranges over P(S^{d-1}), the Borel probability measures on the real unit sphere S^{d-1}⊂R^d; your draft names the sphere but not the admissible class of measures. ([par.nsf.gov](https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10321450))
Quantify the ambient dimension d precisely (d a positive integer, with ambient field R); the paper formulates the problem on the real sphere S^{d-1}. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))

Say explicitly that μ is a global minimizer of I_F over all of P(S^{d-1}), so the question is not misread as being about local minimizers or discrete N-point configurations only. ([par.nsf.gov](https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10321450))
Keep the notation consistent with the paper: F(t)=|t|^p and I_F(μ)=∫∫_{S^{d-1}}|⟨x,y⟩|^p dμ(x)dμ(y). ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))

To stay maximally faithful to arXiv:2504.04845, phrase the hypothesis as p>2 and p≠2k for k∈N; Section 4 makes this restriction because it has just listed the solved cases p=2, 0<p<2, and even p>2. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))

Do not silently strengthen the claim to 'finite discrete measure' unless you intentionally switch to the broader cited Conjecture 1.1; Section 4 itself says only 'discrete measures,' while the cited 2021 source phrases the broader conjecture as 'finite discrete measure.' ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
refined_question: For every positive integer d and every real p>2 with p∉2N, let P(S^{d-1}) be the Borel probability measures on the real unit sphere S^{d-1}⊂R^d, and define F(t)=|t|^p and I_F(μ)=∫_{S^{d-1}}∫_{S^{d-1}}|⟨x,y⟩|^p dμ(x)dμ(y). If μ∈P(S^{d-1}) is a global minimizer of I_F over P(S^{d-1}), must μ be a discrete measure? ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
justification: Your draft is aimed at the correct open problem: Section 4, Conjecture 4.1. That section defines the p-frame energy with kernel F(t)=|t|^p, records the settled regimes p=2, 0<p<2, and even p>2, and then states the conjecture exactly for p>2 and p≠2k. The same paragraph also notes the known partial result that when p is not an even integer, supports of minimizers have empty interior. In the cited source [3], the broader antecedent is Conjecture 1.1 for all p>0 with p∉2N; Theorem 1.3 proves only empty interior of supp(μ), while Theorem 1.2 gives existence of some discrete minimizer for a different class of kernels with finitely many positive Gegenbauer coefficients. So the sharp paper-faithful rewrite is the Section 4 conjecture itself, not the broader Conjecture 1.1 and not an equivalent reformulation, because no such equivalence is proved. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.04845))
